title: Studio performance and report usefulness

requirements.STP01: Keep useful operational, behaviour, quality, financial and support evidence; retire unused or duplicate reports.
requirements.STP02: Remove whole-account/catalogue work from ordinary investigation pages and load only the requested analysis.
requirements.STP03: Preserve exact useful values, inclusive player populations, authorization, redaction and authoritative mutation contracts.
requirements.STP04: Measure task-start/current implementations and validate native PostgreSQL and real browser workflows.

outcome: Implemented locally, not deployed. Runtime data and original analytical facts were not deleted. No new external services or dependencies.

dispositions.decision: Keep incident response, reporting coverage and a current operating pulse. Remove unused lifetime account, restriction, track/version and unique-submitter totals plus the old raw-submission chart.
dispositions.reason: The current overview did not display those lifetime totals, but still computed them on every request. Its useful purpose is identifying current player impact and linking to evidence.
dispositions.implementation: Two report queries: terminal results over the last five minutes and current shared verification queue. Explicit pulse boundaries and all-player definition; selected reporting dates still carry into destination workspaces. The legacy analytics deep link now opens date-filtered race evidence.

dispositions.report: Player and track directories, generic evidence lists
dispositions.decision: Keep search, filters, sorting, current classifications, previews and navigation. Remove exact matching-population totals and per-row player history aggregates.
dispositions.reason: An investigator needs the matching identities and access to their evidence. Recounting the entire catalogue and every displayed player's lifetime races/PBs/publications does not help choose or act on a record.
dispositions.implementation: Scope-fenced forward/backward keyset pages with one-row lookahead, including equal sort values and NULL-last ratings/publication dates. Directory ORM projections omit unused manifests and appearance JSON. Exact canonical IDs use equality. Bounded offset input remains for older links; Studio uses cursors. Page summaries are explicitly page-scoped. A total is only returned when the first page itself proves the complete result; otherwise it is null. Equal-direction keys use a SQL row comparison to permit an actual composite index range; generic evidence ties now follow descending IDs with descending creation time.

dispositions.decision: Keep exact race, PB, publication, case, activity, wallet/access and grant context on the selected player.
dispositions.implementation: Directory rows link to this evidence rather than calculating it for every row. Timeline history is fetched only on the Timeline tab; access, purchases/grants and identity tabs skip the unused history request. Provider subjects, session secrets and private case notes remain redacted.

dispositions.decision: Keep Activity, exact D1/D7/D30 Retention, First-race journey and Engagement. Retire the duplicate Historical totals navigation and the generic cross-report insight on Activity.
dispositions.reason: The historical tab used older parallel definitions. The current four reports answer distinct decisions with common scope/coverage. Automatically running retention and a full funnel to display a generic Activity suggestion imposed substantial work on every tab visit.
dispositions.implementation: Each tab requests only its own view. Activity combines population and counters; retention combines all three return offsets into one grouped query; the journey uses one conditional aggregate instead of rescanning per step. Exact distinct-player handling across multiple context rows, maturity, seven-day provisional follow-up, truncation and business-population gates remain. Combined view=all remains an explicit API option; the default is Activity. Historical stored facts and compatibility API remain.

dispositions.decision: Keep release/baseline comparisons and track/device/frame/network diagnostics.
dispositions.implementation: Combine exact reporting-player and affected-player distinct counts into one aggregate per build. Existing full-scope quality values and bounded detail/selector definitions remain.

dispositions.decision: Keep provider earnings by currency/accounting basis, period Coin sources/sinks, purchase delivery and selected-player wallets. Remove the all-wallet stock sum/count and the unused purchase-state aggregate from the finance response.
dispositions.reason: Current stock totals mix active and inactive wallets and lack a comparison period. Period issuance/spending and individual support evidence are actionable; scanning every wallet on every finance visit is not warranted.
dispositions.implementation: Existing exact date-scoped financial and Coin ledger aggregates remain; opening balances are not earnings. Latest receipt coverage now has a dedicated received_at index. No prices, purchases, wallets, rewards or entitlements were mutated by this task.

dispositions.report: Operations, incidents, competitions, support cases, administration and experiments
dispositions.decision: Keep these workspaces and their commands. They support real operational or product decisions. Preserve their existing bounded inspectors and safeguards.

measurements.fixture: Owned local PostgreSQL 17; 50000 accounts, 50000 wallets, 50000 synthetic provider entries, 10000 observed players and 40000 player-day rows.
measurements.method: Saved task-start Python implementations versus current functions on the same indexed schema. One warm-up and seven measured samples per implementation, alternating order. Useful retained directory fields, activity/retention values and financial flows were compared for equality. Includes database/function work; excludes HTTP, authentication middleware and browser rendering.
measurements.plans: EXPLAIN ANALYZE BUFFERS selects ix_studio_player_created for the directory and ix_studio_finance_received for the latest provider receipt. Full JSON plans are in measurements.json. Before/current functions both used the migrated schema, so the measured function comparison does not isolate the new index's separate benefit. Deep cursor EXPLAIN verifies a ROW(created_at,id) range in ix_studio_player_created with no preceding-row filter scan.
measurements.qualification: These are local warmed medians, not production HTTP latency, cloud sizing, cold-cache, million-DAU or 500-million-account capacity claims.

postgres.remaining_failure: test_projection_batch_has_bounded_sql_work: 500 events / 9431 statements against the existing <60 guard. Current concurrent telemetry diagnostic pipeline; all Studio read/cursor checks pass.

wider_regression.explanation: The two failures asserted retired overview account totals. Their population/classification invariant moved to an exact directory identity-set assertion; all four fixture accounts and the authoritative classification are still required. Targeted replacement assertions pass in support-compatibility.xml: 2 passed, 32 deselected. This is reported as a broad run plus targeted correction, not a pristine full-suite pass.

browser_regression.scope: Real Edge at desktop and 390px, owned local seeded service

browser_focused.scope: Populated directory Next/Previous, sorting, detail return, filter reset, per-tab requests, support history laziness, finance and responsive containment; actual checks are in the artifact

validation.syntax: Ruff passes on all changed Python runtime/tests; bundled Node --check passes on app.js, catalogue.js and platform.js. Screenshots were visually inspected.
initial_corrections: Initial existing tests asserted removed totals/history on directory rows and the previous all-tabs behaviour response. Assertions were moved to the appropriate selected-player or explicit combined view, preserving their factual checks.

Initial new SQL budgets included fixed HTTP rate-budget writes and the indexed bearer lookup. The report-specific trace now explicitly separates those unchanged admission/authentication queries; it does not hide report SQL.

PowerShell pipeline encoding initially changed newly inserted Unicode separators into question marks. They were corrected and actual desktop/390px browser views inspected. Long international names additionally required a Studio-only 2048-character cursor bound; other cursor consumers retain the default 400-character bound.

An initial PostgreSQL selection passed 40 checks and had 12 setup errors before any Studio query: the unrelated concurrent discovery migration 0050 compared json using IS DISTINCT FROM during the legacy fixture's fabricated PB write. The read-only catalogue test fixture now inserts the required stored projections directly and does not fabricate accepted races/PBs. No trigger or invariant was disabled or weakened, and migration 0050 was not modified by this task. The initial error log/XML remain under initial-postgres.*.

Focused browser setup initially navigated before login finished and compared rendered routes with URLs containing automatically added dates/anchors. The fixture now waits for completed login/render and normalizes those automatic URL fields. Initial fixture process logs remain in owned build directories.

final_range_checks.description: Final row-value cursor predicates, ties, both directions and Unicode are covered; deep cursor EXPLAIN verifies a composite index range.

earlier_postgres.qualification: Passed before concurrent telemetry diagnostic wrapper changed; latest broad run reported separately.

validation.concurrent_projection: concurrent-projection.json records the new telemetry wrapper, preserved state-injection change and source fingerprints. No assertion was relaxed.

rollout_and_limits: Local source only. Apply migration 0045_studio_report_reads as part of the current merged migration chain, with a reviewed index-build window or concurrent-index procedure for a large existing ledger. Ship matching API and Studio assets together.

List consumers must use next_cursor/previous_cursor or has_more rather than assuming total is an integer. Cursor names/ratings and visibility remain current and can reorder after mutations; this is an investigation list, not a frozen export.
Behaviour defaults to Activity; callers deliberately requesting a combined response must pass view=all. Removed cross-report suggestions no longer force unrelated analyses to run.

Useful exact behavioural/financial aggregates still grow with observations or ledger entries in the selected period. Rollups/reporting infrastructure and sustained representative load testing remain necessary before a million-DAU capacity claim. Selective filters and non-indexed/custom sorts can still inspect more rows than the returned page; keyset output bounds alone do not prove a bounded query plan.

The initial concurrent discovery migration JSON-comparison failure is outside this Studio change and remains separately recorded. No unrelated backend changes or tests were silently repaired, deleted or weakened.
Owner acceptance and matching rollout remain. No physical phone, phone attachment check, APK, external notification, billing operation or deployment was performed.

The latest broad PostgreSQL run has one telemetry projection SQL-budget failure (500 events / 9431 statements). Resolve the concurrent projector regression before a full-backend rollout. All final Studio read/cursor checks pass; this is not a pristine full-backend pass.
